headline: Language is humanity's superpower—it lets us share ideas across time and space
universal_truth: The ability to transmit complex ideas is what separates us from all other species
fun_facts: There are over 7,000 languages spoken on Earth today
Children naturally acquire language without formal instruction—it's built into human brains
Language lets us discuss the past, plan the future, and imagine things that don't exist
discussion_questions: What could you never communicate without language?
How does language shape the way you think?
What would human civilization look like without language?

hook.script: You can describe a sunset to someone who wasn't there. You can warn a stranger about danger. You can pass on knowledge you'll never use yourself. Language lets ideas travel between minds, across generations, around the world. It's humanity's superpower.

cliff.script: Many animals communicate—bees dance, whales sing, monkeys call. But no other species has language like ours. What makes human language unique? What can we do that no other communication system allows?

options.text: We can combine finite elements infinitely to express any possible idea
options.response: Yes. With limited sounds and rules, we can generate unlimited meanings. That's language's magic.

options.text: We can speak about things that aren't present or don't exist
options.response: Displacement is one feature, but the key is infinite combination...

fact1.title: Infinite From Finite
fact1.script: Human language has a remarkable property: from a limited set of sounds and rules, we can generate an infinite number of sentences. You can say things never said before. Every sentence in this lesson could be completely novel.

fact2.title: Built In
fact2.script: Children acquire language without formal instruction—exposed to speech, they naturally develop grammar. This suggests language isn't just learned; it's built into the human brain. We're wired for language from birth.

fact3.title: Time Travel
fact3.script: Language lets us discuss past and future, not just present. We can plan, remember, and imagine things that don't exist. No other communication system has this 'displacement' feature. Language frees us from the immediate moment.

wisdom.script: Here's today's wisdom: Language isn't just communication—it's the technology that lets human knowledge accumulate across generations. Every word you speak connects you to a chain of minds stretching back to our species' beginnings.

outro.script: That's Day 93. Tomorrow, we'll discover when humans started writing. Until then, marvel that the sounds you're hearing are carrying ideas from my mind to yours.

growTrack.title: Language Appreciation - Notice the Miracle
growTrack.learning_objective: Develop appreciation for language's unique power
growTrack.activity: Today, notice one thing you can only do because of language: explain an abstract idea, discuss the past, plan for tomorrow, or imagine something fictional. Language makes these possible. Appreciate the superpower you use constantly.
